next_guide.basis: Agora guides one quarter ahead and the implied YoY growth of its guides has risen each quarter (Q4'25 guide ~7-10%, Q2'26 13.7-16.6%, Q3'26 15.8-18.6%), and it has beaten the top end twice in 2026, so a Q4 guide of roughly $43.5-45M (14-18% YoY on a ~$38.1M Q4 2025 base derived from FY2025 $141.1M less Q1-Q3 $103.0M) is the expected continuation; no mid-quarter statement changed that, hence 'maintain' the growth pace rather than a step-up.

findings.finding: Agora has beaten the TOP of its own revenue guide in both 2026 quarters (Q1 $37.7M vs $36-37M, +1.9% over the top; Q2 $40.4M vs $39-40M, +1.0% over the top), so Q3 lands most likely at ~$42.3-42.8M against the $41-42M guide (bar = company guide, no street consensus found); this is the expected base case, not a surprise.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 beat the top of the guide and the stock fell -3.93% (2026-08-14); Q4 2025 print -2.56% (2026-03-03); Q3 2025 (+12% revenue, first profitable streak quarters) +9.06% on 2025-11-20. The name has sold two of its last three known beats.
findings.why_not_priced: It mostly is priced: a guide beat is the pattern everyone following the name has seen twice. What is not priced is the size of the beat; if the market expected a larger beat the stock would not have drifted -9% in 20 days into the print.
findings.independence: Q2 beat confirmed in the Q2 release (https://finviz.com/news/382211/agora-inc-reports-second-quarter-2026-financial-results) and in Xinhua's report 'above the top of the guidance range' (https://www.news.cn/finance/20260814/9553c320e1074d32a8344f0c582f8d2e/c.html).

findings.finding: The stock was sold down into the print: -7.0% over 5 days and -8.9% over 20 days, mostly on 2026-11-12 (-5.21%) and 2026-11-13 (-3.18%), with no company-specific news found; spot $3.98 sits 33-41% below the stale mean analyst targets of $5.90-6.80, so the bar the market holds going in is lower than at the Q2 print (stock then ~$4.5-4.7).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 came after a run-up and was sold (-3.93%); Q3 2025, after a weak period, was bought +9.06%. Two cases, opposite setups, consistent with a lower bar helping.
findings.why_not_priced: The drawdown is itself the price; what may not be priced is that it has no company cause found. If the drop reflected leaked bad news there would be a source (none in EDGAR, IR or Chinese press), and the CEO's 10b5-1 buying continued through it (Form 4 filed 2026-11-16). Unexplained microcap drawdowns are weak evidence either way.
findings.independence: Targets from a different source (https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/API/forecast, snapshot 2026-10-01); sealed baseline run-up fields agree on the path.

findings.finding: On its last print (Q2 2026, 2026-08-13) Agora beat the top of its guide by $0.4M and guided Q3 to an accelerating 15.8-18.6% growth, yet the stock fell -3.93% the next session and drifted a reported -11.3% afterwards, showing the shareholder base does not pay for guide beats while gross margin is falling (63.7% vs 66.8% YoY) and operating income is still negative (-2.4% margin).
findings.why_not_priced: This is a reaction-function item, not a fact the market lacks: it says a repeat of the Q2 pattern (beat, margin down, small op loss) is likely to be sold again. If the market already discounted it, the stock would be flat into the print rather than having drifted only after the last one.
findings.independence: Margin and op-loss figures from a different summary (https://vectorshift.ai/research/companies/agora/earnings/2026-q2-summary); the -3.93% from the sealed baseline.

findings.finding: CEO Tony Zhao (Zhao Bin) has bought ADSs on the open market every session since 2026-09-16 under a 10b5-1 plan adopted 2026-06-15: holdings via YY TZ Limited rose from ~1,957,606 to 2,347,872 ADS by 2026-11-13 (~390K ADS, ~$1.6M at ~$4.15), ~9.5K ADS/day or ~8% of the 121K 20-day ADV, with the latest Form 4 filed today (purchases 11-12 at $4.21 and 11-13 at $3.94); the plan announced 2026-06-01 allows up to $20M over 12 months, so it runs well behind a pro-rata pace.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The plan's announcement on 2026-06-01 moved the stock +15.85% (sealed baseline, entry dated 2026-06-01, which is the 6-K for the plan, not a print). The daily execution since September has not prevented a -9% drift.
findings.why_not_priced: The filings are public (Form 4s are new for this foreign private issuer in 2026), but no wire or aggregator covered the purchases; a ~8%-of-volume bid that continues through the window (10b5-1, not blacked out) is a mechanical support for a thin ADS on a negative reaction. If priced, the stock would not have fallen 8% in two sessions while he bought.
findings.independence: Start of buying in the 2026-10-13 Form 4 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1802883/000119312526419691/ownership.xml); plan terms in the 2026-06-01 release (https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/06/01/3304332/0/en/Agora-Inc-Announces-Management-Share-Purchase-Plan.html). Same filer, so one fact.

findings.finding: Next guide: Agora's guided YoY growth has stepped up each quarter (Q4'25 guide ~7-10%, Q2'26 13.7-16.6%, Q3'26 15.8-18.6%) and Q4 2025 is a soft base (~$38.1M derived from FY2025 $141.1M less Q1-Q3 $103.0M), so a Q4 2026 guide of ~$43.5-45M (14-18% YoY) is the likely continuation; with no street Q4 number found, the guide's growth rate vs the Q3 guide's 15.8-18.6% is what the market will read.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q2 print raised the guided growth rate (to 15.8-18.6%) and was still sold -3.93%; Q3 2025's Q4 guide of 7-10% came with a +9.06% day (profitability was the driver). Guide direction has not been decisive for this name on its own.
findings.why_not_priced: No sell-side Q4 number is visible, so the market has no anchored bar; a guide implying deceleration below ~14% would be the first break in the acceleration story, which a -9% pre-print drift partly anticipates. Inference from the guide trajectory, not a company statement about Q4.
findings.independence: Q4 2025 guide $37-38M from https://www.itiger.com/hans/news/2584719549 ; Q2 2026 guide 13.7-16.6% from https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/agora-q1-earnings-call-highlights-020303011.html ; FY2025 $141.1M from the CMC piece. Derived arithmetic.

findings.finding: Management's stated goal is quarterly GAAP operating profitability by year-end 2026 (Q2 operating loss ~$1.0M, -2.4% margin, vs -$3.1M a year earlier; S&M and G&A down YoY, R&D 38.1% of revenue vs 40.8%) while gross margin fell to 63.7% from 66.8% on sub-scale conversational AI but rose sequentially from 63.4%; at ~$42.5M revenue and flat opex, Q3 could print near operating breakeven, and a reaffirmed or achieved target is the new line this print can show.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025, the quarter that established the GAAP net-profit streak, was bought +9.06%; Q2 2026, with a narrowing but still negative operating line and falling gross margin, was sold -3.93%.
findings.why_not_priced: The target is public but undated within the year and no estimate of Q3 operating income is visible; if the market expected an operating-profit quarter now, the stock would not be trading ~10% below its post-Q2 level.
findings.independence: Gross margin 63.7% vs 66.8% confirmed in the release summary (https://finviz.com/news/382211/agora-inc-reports-second-quarter-2026-financial-results) - same company document family, so one source line.

findings.finding: Net cash exceeds the market cap: $361.7M of cash, deposits and financial products at 2026-06-30 against a market cap of ~$365M at the 2026-10-16 close ($4.35), which is ~$334M at today's $3.98; the buyback has slowed to $3.7M in Q2 (cumulative $159.9M, program expires end of February 2027) and management said a special dividend may be considered in the future but not now, so a new or extended return programme is an option the release can carry.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2026-06-01 management purchase plan (a capital signal, not a print) moved the stock +15.85%; no other capital-return announcement in the history window.
findings.why_not_priced: The cash cushion is old and known; what is not priced is any new programme, which has no sourced indication beyond the expiring authorisation and the 'not now' dividend comment. Small, optional upside.
findings.independence: Market cap $365.3M at the 16 Oct close from https://www.cmcmarkets.com/en-au/opto/api-stock-can-agora-turn-conversational-ai-into-a-growth-engine ; dividend comment from https://vectorshift.ai/research/companies/agora/earnings/2026-q2-summary.

findings.link: Same product category: programmable voice/real-time communications APIs and voice-AI agent infrastructure; Agora's US/international division (Agora brand, ~51% of revenue in Q3 2025: $18.2M of $35.4M) sells into the same call-centre voice-agent use case. No shared customers sourced.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No record of API reacting to Twilio prints.
findings.why_not_priced: Demand read-through for voice AI is positive but the market's reaction to Twilio shows guide-driven selling of good quarters in this group; net it is a weak, two-sided signal for a far smaller, China-heavy company.

baseline_tension: There is no option skew to agree or disagree with; the -9% 20-day run-down lowers the bar and the CEO bid supports the stock, which cuts slightly against the name's habit of selling beats, so the net lean is barely above 50.
lessons_applied: Lesson 5 (an unexplained microcap drawdown is worth ~0): the run-down-into-print expectations finding cut from +0.7 to +0.2, kept because the target gap and lower bar are sourced.
Lesson 1 (a verified fact is not a predicted reaction; this name sold its last beat): the guide-beat finding cut from +0.5 to +0.3 and p_up moved from 54 to 52.
Lesson 5 (inference, not a company statement): the next-guide trajectory finding trimmed from +0.5 to +0.4.
Lesson 6 (verify the bar): bar is the company's own guide, so no cap was needed; stated that the expected beat lands just above a range the company itself set.
Left standing: the reaction-history negative (-0.8), CEO 10b5-1 bid (+0.3), operating-profit target (+0.3), capital (+0.3), Twilio peer (+0.2), zeros for mid-quarter and positioning.
